main_text.l: mox ibidem,ubi quę uere sunt permista do
rùm ad id,unde paulò digressi sumus,reuer-
tates integris suis subiectis nec corrumpi,
nec contemperari queunt. Sunt enim sub
suis formis,& per elemetorum formas in-
tensæ ac summæ.Sed nullis in mistis consi-
stunt intensæ.In omnibus enim remissę tan
tummodò sunt. Quod & sane testatur eorū
in rerum natura, quod sit summè calidum,
frigidum simul: aut siccum etiam simul&
frigidum,in quo uincit calorem frigus: uel sic-
cum in quo præpolet humido siccitas: uel

page.notes: Catchword "mentum:" and signature "B 3" are at the foot. The word "cet" at the start of the fifth line is doubtful and marked [?]. Long s was normalised to s throughout. The printed "s" in the second line of the paragraph (the form "lunt") is read as "sunt". The word "elemetorum" is printed that way.
